description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of eleven different relational association categories, likely from the MMRA benchmark dataset. The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, bolded text labels containing the category name, raw count, and percentage in parentheses are positioned directly on or adjacent to their respective slices. None of the segments are visually emphasized through explosion or offsetting. Visually, the slices are arranged in ascending order of size, progressing clockwise starting from the top position. The smallest slice is "NearSameEntity" in dark grey, representing 63 instances (6.34%). Continuing clockwise, the subsequent slices are "RelativePosition" in light grey with 81 (7.90%), "MentalitySimilarity" in light cyan with 89 (8.67%), and four equally sized categories each accounting for 90 instances (8.77%): "SimilarEvent" in light blue, "AppearanceSimilarity" in pale green, "Layout" in pale yellow, and "Environment" in teal. These are followed by "UsageSimilarity" in coral with 100 (9.65%), "SubEvent" in pinkish-red with 100 (9.74%), and "SimilarMaterial" in orange with 106 (10.33%). Finally, the largest slice is "ObservationAngle" in turquoise, comprising 126 instances (12.28%).
